name: Doren
summary: At the Rebel Camp, Doren leads soldiers who have turned against Colonel Kurzen. They once served on Stormwind's expedition and now seek the cause of his madness.

sections.title: A Mutiny in the Jungle
sections.body: Lieutenant Doren leads the Rebel Camp beside the road in Stranglethorn Vale. He came south under Stormwind's banner with Colonel Kurzen on an expedition to establish a foothold in the jungle. But Kurzen and his inner circle grew erratic and violent. Doren would not follow them into madness, so he and loyal soldiers broke ranks and fled north. They chose defection over service to a mad commander.

sections.title: Uncovering the Truth
sections.body: Doren directs attacks on Kurzen's Compound and keeps his dwindling troops supplied through neutral contacts, including Krazek in Booty Bay. He sends spies such as Private Thorsen behind enemy lines to learn what afflicted Kurzen and to find traitors and collaborators like Bookie Herod. Doren believes ending Kurzen is the only way to preserve what remains of the expedition's honor.

faq.answer: Lieutenant Doren leads the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale. He once served Colonel Kurzen on a Stormwind expedition, then led soldiers who refused to follow Kurzen after he went mad.

faq.q: Why is Doren considered a rebel?
aliases: why is it called rebel camp
faq.answer: Doren and his soldiers mutinied against their commander, Colonel Kurzen. Kurzen led the expedition under Stormwind's authority, so Doren and his followers became rebels when they broke away and took up arms against him. They seek to preserve their sanity and oppose his tyranny.
Doren does not know what caused the madness that afflicted Kurzen and his inner circle. He sends spies and scouts to learn what corrupted his former commander in the jungle.

faq.q: How does Doren keep the Rebel Camp supplied?
faq.answer: Doren keeps the Rebel Camp supplied through covert runs and arrangements with neutral parties. He works with goblin merchants such as Krazek in Booty Bay to outfit his troops.

faq.q: Who is Bookie Herod and what is his connection to Doren?
faq.answer: Bookie Herod is an associate of Kurzen's forces. Doren suspects Herod helped uncover the loyalties of Private Thorsen, Doren's agent inside the compound.
Doren broke ranks with his commander and now acts on his own, while remaining loyal to the Alliance's ideals. He welcomes Alliance adventurers who can help set right the failed expedition.

angles.text: As an Alliance soldier, you can help Doren confront the fallout of Stormwind's jungle expedition and restore order in the frontier.
As a human traveler, you may recognize Doren's military discipline. His story shows the toll that isolated service far from Stormwind can take on mind and morale.
